about: A day given notes (its row made then, with the series' tags and people copied onto it), then a place, then a title for all events with another day renamed at Google during it; the notes undone keep the row for its place and take away the links the notes' entry gave it, a redo gives them back, and a redo of that redo takes them away again: a day row's tags and people are its own links, put back exactly as a set, never re-derived from the series (decisions.md, "The undo of a Google edit sends back only the fields that edit changed"; seed 307 case 183; x-undo-fields)
